author: Ronnie
focus: Pause the needle application; examine an exterior connection-geometry construction for the fixed Free Numbers length-two coordinates.
question: Can prescribed based-loop holonomies be encoded in B2, transported with a connection, and compared in a gauge-covariant way while distinguishing midpoint insertion from an appended operation?
arithmetic: exact fractions over rational unit quaternions; no numerical integration
group: SU(2), represented by unit quaternions; a non-Abelian KK-inspired exterior construction, not the original 5D U(1) model
graph: three triangles based at b plus one connector b->r; reverse links are inverses
link_construction: For each triangle prescribe two rational unit links p,q and a target loop holonomy h, then set the closing link to h*(q*p)^-1. The targets are inputs, not discoveries.
compression_convention: T=u tensor v records first u, then v; m2(T)=v*u
readout: w dot Ad(U) v; adjoint charge/source and analyzer are transformed with the local gauge frame
transport: R(P) T R(P)^T and R(P) S R(P)^T; P is the ordered connector holonomy
second_route: traverse z loop before connector P: Q=P*h_z
expected_contrasts: x twice and y twice both have full SU(2) holonomy -1, stronger than only equal trace
all identically appended operations agree; endpoint-equivalent Markov evolution has no hidden later divergence
insert the same probe between the two loops: readouts differ, +24/25 versus -24/25
value plus B2 residual reconstructs each midpoint insertion exactly
canonical value lift alone is not a unitary path and must not be promoted to a physical unitary prediction
connection transport preserves compression and the residual-response identity, in the appropriate frames
two connector routes with the same endpoints can rotate the residual differently; compare with one common transported probe
round-trip transport along P and its reverse returns the residual; z then P then reverse P can change it
independent local gauge changes preserve all complete experimental readouts
an Abelian U(1) subgroup control does not show this noncommuting midpoint contrast
scope_limits: no KK field equations or geodesics solved
no new force or extra-dimension observation
no claim that residuals are the extra spin components of a KK particle
no claim of superiority over ordinary tensors or storing the full path
no free response difference after identical full endpoint state without a midpoint interaction
construction_disclosure: The rational loop targets and probe were deliberately selected to instantiate the established B2 insertion identities. This is an explicit gauge-covariant bridge and boundary test, not a blinded prediction or independent audit.
